title: Gelasius of Cyzicus, Acts of the First Council (Nicaea)
english: I read the Acts of the first council in three volumes. It bears the name of Gelasius, but is rather a history than Acts. The author's style is poor and mean, but he gives a detailed account of the proceedings of the council.
translator_notes: Pass A≠B for claim photius-bibliotheca-densify; justification reviews/justifications/bibl_codex_15.json
Greek locked from Bekker 1824; Freese 1920 used as PD English reference only.

Codex 15 of 279; Gelasius of Cyzicus (fl. c. 475), Acts of the First Council of Nicaea (325). Three volumes; Photius calls it more history than acts. Style poor but detailed account. First Council of Nicaea (325) defined Christ's divinity against Arianism.
